mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO api_usage_log (request_id, tenant_id, model_name, provider, channel_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_ms, finish_reason, estimated, create_time) VALUES (#{log.requestId}, #{log.tenantId}, #{log.modelName}, #{log.provider}, #{log.channelId}, #{log.promptTokens}, #{log.completionTokens}, #{log.totalTokens}, #{log.costMs}, #{log.finishReason}, #{log.estimated}, COALESCE(#{log.createTime}, NOW(3)))
